# v0.9.0 — Stable charging controls and Modbus app

Stable release of the 0.9 series, compared with the last stable version 0.8.2.

- **Simpler charging:** shared kWh and target-time limits, optional vehicle
  percentage target and one button to start a guest charge. The first active
  guest limit reached stops charging.
- **Reliable operation:** the app carries an accepted departure plan and proven
  same-plug guest permission through Home Assistant Core restarts. Planning
  adapts to the vehicle’s measured charging power. Charging-loss and cost
  estimates now survive failed polls and the plug-in and unplug transitions.
- **Clearer interface:** new app overview and decoded diagnostics, a wallbox
  event entity, fewer redundant sensors, refreshed guides and five Mushroom
  dashboards. Bounded events and fewer state changes limit database load.

**Updating from 0.8.2:** update the app to **0.9.0** first (API 2), then the
integration. The old charging-job, boost and reserve APIs, plus separate guest
draft, stop and clear controls, are removed. **Start guest charging** remains.
Update affected automations and dashboards. Earlier beta storage is
not migrated. If HA reports rejected app state, acknowledge the safe reset and
recheck pause, charging release, Plug & Charge, limits and vehicle planning.
